display.title: Boss Lairs
description: Cataclysm's arenas, Mowzie's monasteries, Aether dungeon reward rooms. The boss is the point; chests are the bonus.
&ePrepare:&r Your best build. Read the boss: telegraphs are visible on every profile.
&eSignature rewards:&r The boss drop and first-kill trophy/heart (see legends). Chests give cores and strong affix gear.
&eComing back:&r First kill is the big reward (once per player); some Cataclysm bosses can be re-summoned for gear, not relics.
&eFeeds into:&r Trophies for the Hall of Legends; cores -> sockets.
&aObjective:&r Step inside any structure of this family.
&bWhy it matters:&r Knowing what a family offers before you go makes the trip worth it.
